home.heading: Welcome to the tennis planner
home.body: Plan training periods, submit your preferences, and stay up to date — all in one place.

signIn.heading: Sign in
signIn.helpText: You'll get an email with a link to sign in. No password needed.

new.heading: New training period
new.intro: Set up the season: pick the dates, how long a training lasts, and the weekly schedule. The app generates one training session for each matching day in the range.
new.durationHelp: How long one training lasts. Each block's end time follows from its start plus this.
new.slotsHelp: Add each training block: which day, its start time, the group size, and a trainer. Days can run at different times, and two blocks may share a time (parallel trainings on different courts).
new.deadlineHelp: Players can submit and edit their preferences until this moment. It must fall before the first training.
new.priceHelp: The amount one player pays for the whole period, e.g. 300 for a 4-person group or 600 for a 2-person group.
new.trainersEmpty: No members with the trainer role yet — you can add trainers later.

errors.datesInvalid: Enter a valid start and end date.
errors.datesOutOfOrder: The end date must not be before the start date.
errors.durationInvalid: Choose how long a training lasts.
errors.slotsRequired: Add at least one training block.
errors.slotWeekdayInvalid: Pick a valid day for each training block.
errors.slotTimesInvalid: Enter a valid start time (HH:mm) for each block.
errors.slotEndsPastMidnight: A training can't run past midnight — use an earlier start or a shorter duration.
errors.slotCapacityInvalid: Enter a group size of 1 or more for each block.
errors.deadlineAfterFirstTraining: The preference deadline must fall before the first training.
errors.priceInvalid: Enter a valid price, e.g. 300 or 12,50.

detail.finalScheduleHint: This plan is published and final. You'll see your assigned training here.
detail.noSlots: No training blocks in this period.
detail.sessionsSummary: {count, plural, one {# training session} other {# training sessions}} generated across the period.
detail.previewBanner: Preview — this is what a player sees.
detail.openHint: Opening the period makes it visible to players so they can submit preferences.
detail.confirmOpenBody: Players will be able to see this period and submit their preferences. You can't move it back to draft afterwards.
detail.startPlanningHint: The deadline has passed. Lock the period to start final planning.
detail.waitForDeadline: Final planning becomes available once the preference deadline has passed.
detail.publishHint: Publishing confirms the schedule and trainer plan above as final for all players.
detail.publishedNote: The final plan is published and visible to all players.
detail.preferencesClosed: The preference deadline has passed; preferences can no longer be changed.

preferenceForm.weekdaysLabel: Which training days work for you?
preferenceForm.saved: Your preferences have been saved. You can edit them until the deadline.

errors.weekdaysRequired: Select at least one training day.
errors.weekdaysNotOffered: Pick only days this period trains on.
errors.skillLevelInvalid: Choose a skill level from 1 to 9.
